name: WittyPDF
summary: PDFs with selectable text, zoom, outline, thumbnails and search.
updates: The PDF reader itself: zoom, outline, thumbnails, search, study tools and its look.
stays: pdf.js and its worker, which do the actual reading of a PDF, stay with the server, along with the Reader page, the ReaderHost it provides (saving your place and notes) and React. If this bundle fails, the copy in the app takes over.
